add_route.title: Add a route
add_route.description: Get the travel time, delay and arrival time of the fastest route between two places, with live traffic. For each end, pin a location on the map or pick a zone, person or device tracker (its live position is used, so you can route from where you are). If you fill in both, the entity is used.
